items.textToSpeech: No recommendations for sulphur intake have been established. However, the following substances contain sulphur. Thiamin hydrochloride (a form of vitamin B1) is 9.5% sulphur by weight. Biotin (also known as vitamin B7) is 13.1% sulphur by weight. The essential amino acid methionine is 21.5% sulphur by weight. The essential amino acid cysteine is 26.5% sulphur by weight.
